description: A key from another environment: every signed demo REST call answers the 10003 invalid-key reply and the demo private WS closes the connection on auth. Server time still answers. Live hosts are never stubbed: any live-host request is a defect.

expected.outcome: Refused (check: environment) with 'key does not belong to this environment'; not persisted; the request log shows every signed request and private-WS attempt on demo hosts only, none on a live host (the live public market-data stream is expected).
